source_text:
3.9
Ἀφρικανοῦ· πρὸς ὠταλγίαν Ὦτα δὲ βούλομαι τρόπῳ ὠφελῆσαι διπλῷ· ἵνα καὶ
ἀλγοῦντα παύσηται καὶ παυσάμενα μηκέτι ἀλγῇ. Ὅταν γὰρ δύσοιστον καὶ ἀπόφορον
τὸ περὶ οὖς γένηται πάθος ὡς ἑλκῶν γινομένων πῦά τε δυσώδη καὶ σκώληκας
ἐκθρέψαι, δυσανασχέτου τῆς περὶ αὐτὰ γινομένης ὀδύνης, περδίκιος βοτάνη,
εὐτελὴς μὲν καὶ φυομένη πανταχοῦ, ὥσπερ τῆς φύσεως τῷ εὐπόρῳ φιλοτιμουμένης,
συγκόπτεται ἰσχυρῶς, ὡς πολὺν αὐτῆς τὸν χυλὸν γενέσθαι. Εἶτα μέλιτος Ἀττικοῦ
ὀλίγον λαμβάνεται καὶ ὄξους δριμέος οὐ πολὺ καὶ ὑλῶν θαλαττίων βραχύ. Ταῦτα
μιγέντα καὶ χλιανθέντα τῷ πονοῦντι γίνεται σωτηρία.
pass_a_gloss: 3.9 Of-Africanus: toward ear-pain. Ears but I-wish by-a-manner to-help double: so-that both being-in-pain they-cease and having-ceased no-longer they-pain. When for hard-to-bear and to-be-carried-away the about ear becomes affection as of-sores becoming pus both foul-smelling and worms to-rear, hard-to-endure of-the about them becoming pain, of-partridge herb, cheap yes and growing everywhere, as-if of-nature with-the easy-to-get being-ambitious, is-chopped strongly, so-that much of-it the juice become. Then of-honey Attic a-little is-taken and of-vinegar sharp not much and of-matters sea a-little. These having-been-mixed and having-been-warmed to-the-suffering becomes salvation.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: toward earache. I wish to help the ears in a double manner: so that both, being in pain, they cease, and having ceased they no longer pain. For when the affection about the ear becomes hard to bear and to carry away, sores coming to be, and it rears foul-smelling pus and worms, the pain that comes about them hard to endure — partridge-herb, cheap and growing everywhere, as if nature were ambitious with what is easy to get, is chopped strongly, so that much juice of it comes to be. Then a little Attic honey is taken, and not much sharp vinegar, and a little of sea-stuffs. These, mixed and warmed, become salvation to the one in pain.

choices.why: The help is two-fold: cease the pain, and not pain again. Not 'help twice'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
